abstract.text: A Route orders the places to visit during an Activity. Each Stop refers to a Project Location.

inlineContent.text: Create a Route in the Activity, choose Project Locations, and arrange its Stops. A Route can be linked to an Assignment. Selecting an Activity or Assignment on the Map shows the relevant route overlay. Stop resource balances come from Transactions; the Route itself is navigation context, not a resource endpoint.

abstract.text: Plan places, resources, and shared work across iOS and the web.

A Transaction records a positive quantity of one Item moving between resource anchors. Inventory, Activity, Assignment, and Stop are anchors; a balance equals incoming quantities minus outgoing quantities.
Locations are reusable Project places: entrances, rooms, checkpoints, stations, or delivery points.
